depth_justification: The same analysis block (Reflection Questions 9, 10, 11 on bias/drift/hallucination) is repeated verbatim four times with no new information, a severe looping defect, and citations are repeatedly wrong (GDPR Art. 82 invoked for transparency/automated decisions when it concerns compensation).
